patch.name: checkout-timeout.patch
patch.text:
diff --git a/services/checkout/handler.py b/services/checkout/handler.py
--- a/services/checkout/handler.py
+++ b/services/checkout/handler.py
@@ -20 +20,2 @@ def payment_status(gateway, order):
-    return gateway.fetch(order)
+    status = gateway.fetch(order, timeout=4)
+    return status if status is not None else "pending"
